mapper.select: SELECT tags.id AS tag_id, tags.name, tags.normalized_key, COUNT(DISTINCT document_tags.source_document_id) AS document_count, MAX(document_tags.updated_at) AS updated_at FROM tags INNER JOIN document_tags ON document_tags.space_id = tags.space_id AND document_tags.tag_id = tags.id AND document_tags.status = 'confirmed' INNER JOIN source_documents ON source_documents.space_id = document_tags.space_id AND source_documents.id = document_tags.source_document_id AND source_documents.status = 'active' WHERE tags.space_id = #{spaceId} AND tags.status = 'active' GROUP BY tags.id, tags.name, tags.normalized_key ORDER BY document_count DESC, tags.name ASC, tags.id ASC
